integrity: Exact general combinatorial matching and signed Lefschetz proof; standalone finite checker n=3..8 tests boundary, acyclicity, mod-2 ranks; automorphism tests n=3..6. Finite checks are not the proof for all n.
scientific_limitations: The integer homotopy type is non-equivariant; group representation refinement is rational only. No classification outside crown graphs, and no integral equivariant representation is asserted. Some unindexed prior coverage cannot be excluded.
title: Two-independence complexes of crown graphs and their full rational symmetry characters
